name: AbyssalEchoes
description: A nova that echoes from up to 8 enemies it reaches and applies abyssal decay. Enemies with abyssal decay take void damage over time for 5 seconds, if they take a hit all the damage from abyssal decay is dealt to them immediately.
altText:
Abyssal decay deals a total of 100 void damage over its duration, with added spell damage applied at 100% effectiveness each second.

Abyssal Echoes cannot apply other on hit effects on hit.

name: AcidFlask
description: Throw a flask of acid that explodes dealing physical damage on impact, poisoning enemies and reducing their armor.
altText:
Added damage applies at 125% effectiveness.
Your shadows can imitate this ability when you directly use it.

name: Acolyte Evade
description:
Rapidly move a short distance forwards.

Evading does not grant damage immunity or prevent abilities from hitting you.

Evade gains 0.5% Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed per Character level.

name: Aegis
description: Briefly gain 70% additional block chance.

name: Anomaly
description: Combo skill that first sends enemies forward in time by 5 seconds. Reactivate the skill to bring those enemies back to your timeline early.
altText: Bosses are only sent forward by a millisecond, causing return effects to occur immediately without them visually disappearing.

name: ArcaneAscendance
description: Toggle to prevent movement and drain 25 mana each second. Mana drain increases by 1 mana per second. All spells cost +5 mana to cast. 100% increased spell damage and 50% increased cast speed. Also deals lightning damage over time to surrounding enemies.
altText: Added damage is applied at 45% effectiveness.

name: AssassinArrow
description: Fires an arrow that seeks out a specific enemy target. Ignoring other enemies in its path.

name: AssembleAbomination
description:
Hold ability key to channel to absorb your Wraiths, Summoned Skeletons, Skeletal Mages, Golems, and Volatile Zombies in an area. When you release, summon a single hulking abomination with added health and more damage per minion absorbed.

The abomination remembers the minions absorbed to create it and will rapidly devour those minions to restore 10% of its maximum health.
altText:
Abomination gains health equal to the max health of minions consumed and 5% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per minion consumed (up to 20 minions).
All minions of the same type are devoured if any one of them are absorbed. For example, Skeleton Warriors, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Archers are the same type of Summoned Skeleton.

name: AuraOfDecay
description:
Toggles Aura of Decay, which poisons you every second, and leaves a trail of decay. Enemies near you or in the trail are poisoned four times a second, and your chance to poison on hit applies to each of these instances at 100% effectiveness.

While Aura of Decay is active you take 30% less poison damage. Additionally, you take 50% less damage from your own Aura of Decay.
altText: Your chance to poison on hit does not increase the rate at which poison is applied to you.

name: Avalanche
description: Summon the might of winter and pummel your foes in ice and snow, unleashing a large boulder at the target followed by 10 smaller boulders around the area over 2 seconds.
altText:
Added damage is applied at 400% effectiveness. Each hit has a freeze rate of 80.
The large boulder deals 100% more damage and has 100% more area of effect (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

Increased Area for Area Skills stats apply to the area of the individual boulders, but not to the area in which they fall.

name: BasicPlayerAttack
description: A basic attack with your weapon that costs no mana

name: BlackHole
description: Summon a powerful black hole at target location that aggressively pulls enemies and deals cold damage over time to enemies within its reach.
altText: Added spell damage is applied at 800% effectiveness per second. The Black Hole persists for 2.75s by default.

name: Bladestorm Throw
description:
Throw spinning blades towards the target location where they will hit nearby enemies 3 times per second. 

Bladestorms last 4 seconds. You can have a maximum of 3 Bladestorms active at once, but each enemy can only take damage from one at a time.
altText:
Bladestorms hit 3 times per second, and added damage applies at 150% effectiveness to each hit.
Bladestorms have 40% less chance to apply ailments on hit.

name: BloodTether
description:
Tethers an enemy, drawing blood from them to deal physical damage over time. Deals 1% more damage per bleed on the target.

3% of damage dealt is leeched as health.
altText:
An enemy cannot have more than one tether at a time. Tethers last 3 seconds.

Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness per second.

name: BoneCurse
description: Apply a curse to enemies in an area for 8 seconds that causes physical damage when hit. The damage is tripled if you inflicted the hit yourself.
altText:
Added spell damage applies at 20% effectiveness to each hit.

When the curse deals damage it counts as an additional hit, but cannot apply ailments from effects such as "chance to ignite on hit".

name: BoneNova
description: Bones fly out in all directions, impaling enemies.
altText: Added damage is applied at 125% effectiveness.

name: CallOfTheHunt
description: Call your minions to hunt a specific target. The target takes 10% increased damage for 3 seconds. This debuff can stack multiple times but can only be on one target at once.

name: ChannelledHungeringSouls
description:
Calls forth five hungering souls that seeks out enemies, on hit they deal necrotic damage and then possesses the target.

Possessed enemies take necrotic damage over time for 1.5 seconds. Enemies cannot be possessed by multiple souls at once.
altText:
Possess's damage counts as spell damage and it is affected by modifiers to base spell damage.

Added spell damage applies to the initial hit at 45% effectiveness and to possess at 75% effectiveness over its full duration.

name: ChargedGround
description:
Charges an area of ground, causing repeated bursts of lightning in smaller areas within it.

Static Orb's damage and area bonuses based on distance travelled also apply to the Charged Ground.
altText: 150% of added damage applied per second.

name: CinderStrike
description:
A combo ability with three attacks. The first attack also creates a fiery explosion, damaging nearby enemies.

Can be used with a bow or melee weapon.
altText:
The consecutive attack counter resets if you go 2 seconds without using Cinder Strike.

Added damage applies to the first attack at 250% effectiveness, and to the other attacks at 100% effectiveness.

name: DancingStrike1
description:
Requires dual wielding.

A combo ability that is a series of fast dash attacks. Dancing Strikes gains increased movement speed and more damage equal to 50% of your total increased melee attack speed.
altText:
Added damage is applied to each attack at 150% effectiveness.

Your total increased melee attack speed includes the modifier from attack rate and generic increased attack speed stats. If your {Melee Attack Speed} is 1.5, then Dancing Strikes gains 25% increased movement speed and 25% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Dancing Strikes cannot gain more than 100% increased movement speed.

name: DarkFissure
description: A powerful melee attack that leaves a dark fissure that lasts 4 seconds. Enemies near the fissure are inflected with despair, which reduces their damage by 40%.

name: DarkQuiver
description:
Requires a bow.

Summons 7 Black Arrows that rain from the sky over 4 seconds, granting 100% increased damage to your next bow attack when retrieved.
altText: You can hold up to 3 Black Arrows at once, but can only expend one at a time.

name: DeathSeal
description:
Toggle to seal your health, preventing it from going above its current value for 3 seconds. While sealed you take less damage equal to half your percent missing health, and 90% of hit damage taken is dealt over 4 seconds. 

Reactivate to unleash a Wave of Death dealing damage based on how long Death Seal has been active and your current percent missing health.
altText:
The Wave of Death deals up to 20% more damage per second Death Seal has been active and deal 1% more damage per 1% missing health. Both effects are multiplicative with other modifiers.

Added spell damage applies at 500% effectiveness to Wave of Death.

Hit damage that is dealt over 4 seconds cannot be altered after the hit and is unaffected by temporary immunity effects. It does not count as damage over time.

name: Decoy
description: Throw a device to create a Decoy that taunts enemies around it for 2.5 seconds before exploding.
altText:
Added throwing attack damage is applied at 600% effectiveness to the explosion.

The Decoy cannot be destroyed before it expires.

name: DetonateCorpse
description: Detonates the corpse of an enemy, dealing physical damage to living enemies around it. Added damage applies at double effectiveness.

name: DetonatingArrow
description:
Requires a bow.

Fires an arrow that embeds itself in a target then explodes after 0.6 seconds.
altText: Added bow damage applies to the arrow at 125% effectiveness and to the explosion at 200% effectiveness.

name: DevouringOrb
description:
Creates a devouring orb at the target location for 10 seconds that deals void damage over time to nearby enemies, and casts a void rift whenever something dies nearby, hitting nearby enemies to deal void damage.

Each successive rift has 12% more damage and area of effect, capped at an increase of 120%.
altText:
Added damage is applied to the damage over time area at 100% effectiveness per second, and to the Void Rifts at 75% effectiveness.

Devouring orb cannot cast more than one void rift every 0.1 seconds.

name: Disintegrate
description: Channel to create a beam of pure energy in the target direction. The beam deals fire and lightning damage to all enemies caught in it.
altText: Added damage applies at 480% effectiveness each second. Damage reduces while rotating.

name: DrainLife
description: Channelled spell that targets up to 3 enemies around the target location, dealing necrotic damage over time and leeching 30% of that damage back as health.
altText: Added spell damage applies at 360% effectiveness per second.

name: DreadShade
description: Your minion's health is drained for 3% of its max health per second for each second the shade has been active, but it and your minions around it deal +10 necrotic damage with spells and attacks and have 50% increased necrotic damage.
altText:
Each minion only benefits from one Dread Shade aura. Max 4 active shades.

Your maximum number of shades is shared with Infernal Shade.

name: Dreamslash
description:
Requires a melee weapon.
Dash forwards if not within range of your target, hitting all enemies along the path, then perform a quick slash.
Shadows performing Dreamslash dash beyond their target, hitting all enemies along the path.
altText:
Added damage applies at 150% effectiveness. Shadows will only be consumed if within 12 meters of the target.
The dash and the slash deal the same amount of damage, and an enemy can only be hit by one of them.

name: Earthquake
description: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area around you sending out tremors to nearby enemies.

name: EarthquakeSlam
description: Slam the ground with your weapon damaging enemies in a large area and creating 2 to 4 aftershocks nearby.
altText: Added melee damage applies at 700% effectiveness.

name: ElementalNova
description:
Casts a nova around you that deals fire, cold and lightning damage.

All types of Elemental Nova that you have enabled have an equal chance to be cast.
altText: Added damage is applied at 120% effectiveness.

name: EnchantWeapon
description:
Active: Enchant your weapon with elemental power. Your melee attacks deal 50% more elemental damage for 5 seconds.

Passive: Your melee attacks deal 15% more elemental damage.
altText: Multiplicative with other damage modifiers

name: EntanglingRoots
description:
Call forth a wave of roots that grows outwards in a wide cone in front of you. The wave deals physical damage and roots enemies it hits for 1.5 seconds. Rooted enemies take physical damage over time until they are freed.

Added spell damage applies at 100% to the initial hit and 300% per second to the damage over time.
altText: Enemies can be affected by multiple roots at once, and will take damage from each.

name: ErasingStrike
description: A melee attack that hits all enemies in a large area in front of you. Enemies killed by the hit are erased from existence, replaced by void rifts.
altText: Added melee damage has 600% effectiveness on the initial hit, but none on the void rifts, which are void spells.

name: Eterras Blessing
description: The nearest allied target is healed for 100 health. If the target is one of your minions then the healing is tripled and the minion is energised for 4 seconds, increasing its size by 20% and its damage by 100%.

name: Fade
description: Increase dodge rating and movement speed until you next attack.

name: Falconer 00 Falconry
description:
Passive:
Summons a {Falcon} that fights with you.

Active:
{Falcon Strikes}: The {Falcon} rapidly hits many enemies in the target area.
altText: The Falcon cannot take damage and is untargetable by enemies. Press {A} to give your minions an attack command.

name: Falconer 02 Aerial Assault
description: You leap towards the target and your {Falcon} dives to catch you and momentarily carry you further, before it flies up and unleashes a {Wing Burst} at the target location.
altText: The Wing Burst deals physical throwing damage and scales with your Falcon's stats.

name: Falconer 03 Dive Bomb
description: Your {Falcon} ascends high into the sky then dive bombs the target location at high speed, dealing a high amount of physical damage to enemies in the area.
altText:
Your falcon's added damage applies at 500% effectiveness.
If Dive Bomb is interrupted before impact, 70% of the cooldown and mana cost are recovered.

name: Falconer 04 Explosive Trap
description:
Throws a trap that explodes when triggered, dealing throwing fire damage. Traps take 0.4 seconds to arm and explode when enemies walk over them or after 30s. 

You can have a maximum of 6 active traps at a time.
altText: Added damage applies at 150% effectiveness to the explosion.

name: Falconer 05 Net
description: Leaps backwards and throws a net which snares enemies and deals physical damage. Netted bosses and rare enemies have 35% less movement speed, and other enemies are immobilized.
altText:
Added damage applies at 100% effectiveness.
Nets last 3-5 seconds at random on each enemy.

name: Fireball
description: Cast a ball of fire towards the target. Has 40% chance to ignite on hit. Added spell damage applies at 125% effectiveness.

name: Firebrand
description: A melee attack which grants you a stack of Firebrand buff if it hits an enemy. Each stack of the Firebrand buff increases the size of subsequent Firebrand attacks and adds melee fire damage.
altText:
Firebrand can stack up to 4 times. Each stack grants +5 melee fire damage, increases the size of Firebrand attacks by 25% and lasts for 4 seconds.

Added damage is applied at 150% effectiveness.

name: FlameReave
description: A melee attack that releases a wave of flames from your weapon, cleaving through enemies in a cone in front of you. Deals less damage as it expands, up to 50% less at maximum distance.
altText: Added damage applies at 400% effectiveness.

name: FlameWard
description: Grants a burst of 400 ward. Then for 3 seconds, hits deal 30% less damage to you and cause a retaliatory burst of flames.
altText:
Added spell damage applies to the burst of flames at 200% effectiveness.

The area of effect of the burst of flames scales with increased Area of Area Skills stats.

name: Flay 1
description:
Spirit Step up to 3 meters towards an enemy if not within range, then perform a narrow rending slash.
Each enemy killed by the melee attack will release a Blood Eruption, a spell dealing physical damage in an area.
Enemies can be hit by both Flay and all Blood Eruptions that occur.
altText:
The melee attack has 200% effectiveness of added melee damage.
The Blood Eruption has 200% effectiveness of added spell damage.

name: Flurry
description: A bow or melee attack that performs 3 rapid strikes. The last strike can be cancelled by moving.
altText:
Added damage applies at 80% effectiveness to each strike and each strike has a 40% reduced chance to apply ailments on hit.

Increased Area for Area skills stats only affect the melee version of Flurry.

name: Focus
description: Hold ability key to channel. While channelling you have 100% increased mana regen and gain 10 ward per second. After channelling for exactly one second you recover 10% of missing mana and gain a burst of 40 mana and ward.

name: ForgeStrike
description:
A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you.

25% chance on hit to summon a Forged Weapon which lasts for 20 seconds and is affected by the stats and attack rate of your weapon. You can control up to 6 Forged Weapons at once.
altText: Added melee damage applies at 600% effectiveness.

name: Frost Claw
description: Three projectiles arc to the target location to create a burst of frost. Added spell damage applies to the burst at 100% effectiveness and it has a freeze rate of 40.

name: FuryLeap
description: Leap to the target location, dealing damage to nearby enemies when you hit the ground.
altText:
Added damage is applied at 250% effectiveness.

Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

name: GatheringStormMelee
description: Strike at your enemy with a mighty lightning powered storm. When you use Gathering Storm and hit at least one enemy, you gain a {Storm Stack}. Every second you expend a Storm Stack to cause a {Storm Bolt} to strike a nearby enemy. This interval is reduced by 2% for every stack you currently have.
altText:
The attack deals melee lightning damage with added damage applying at 100% effectiveness, and the {Storm Bolt} deals spell lightning damage with added damage applying at 100% effectiveness.

Increased area for area skills stats apply to the melee attack and to the damage area of the {Storm Bolt}, but not to the area in which enemies are targeted by {Storm Bolts}.

name: Glacier
description: Creates three successively larger ice explosions in the target direction. Each explosion deals more damage than the last.
altText:
Added damage is applied at double effectiveness to the middle explosion, and at quadruple effectiveness to the largest explosion.

The smallest explosion has a freeze rate of 40, the middle explosion has a freeze rate of 70, and the largest explosion has a freeze rate of 140.

Added spell damage applies at 100% effectiveness to the smallest explosion, 175% effectiveness to the middle explosion, and 350% effectiveness to the largest explosion.

name: GlyphOfFire
description: Create a glyph that detonates after 1.3 seconds.

name: HailOfArrows
description:
Requires a bow.

Launch a hail of arrows into the sky that rain down on the target location over 3.5 seconds.
altText: Added bow damage is applied at 325% effectiveness per second.

name: HammerThrow
description:
Throws a hammer that returns to you after a short delay.

Added Throwing Damage is applied to each hit at 110% effectiveness.
altText: This is a throwing attack that scales with throwing attack damage and throwing attack speed. It is not a melee attack or spell.

name: Harvest
description: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you, dealing double damage to those that are Cursed.
altText: Unaffected by weapon range. Added damage applies at 70% effectiveness. Common curses include Marked for Death, Bone Curse and Spirit Plague.

name: HealingHands
description: Heals all allies in a target area for 50 health and applies a lingering warmth which heals 80 health over the next 3 seconds. The lingering warmth cannot stack on the same target.

name: Heartseeker
description:
Requires a bow.

Shoot an arrow that seeks the heart of a nearby target, passing harmlessly through other enemies. Whenever it hits its target it has a chance to continue through it and {Recurve} to strike it again. 

Subsequent {Recurve} chance is multiplied by 0.8 each time the arrow {Recurves}. If the target dies, it will choose a new target.
altText:
Base recurve chance is 100%.

Added damage applies at 100% effectiveness.

name: HolyAura
description: You and nearby allies passively gain 30% increased damage and +15% additional elemental resistance. Activating Holy Aura doubles the stat bonuses for 4 seconds.

name: HungeringSouls
description:
Calls forth five hungering souls that seeks out enemies, on hit they deal necrotic damage and then possesses the target.

Possessed enemies take necrotic damage over time for 1.5 seconds. Enemies cannot be possessed by multiple souls at once.
altText:
Possess's damage counts as spell damage and it is affected by modifiers to base spell damage.

Added spell damage applies to the initial hit at 45% effectiveness and to possess at 75% effectiveness over its full duration.

name: IceBarrage
description: Opens a rift that repeatedly shoots a barrage of ice shards in a target direction for 5 seconds.
altText:
Ice Shards are cold projectiles that will curve to nearby targets.

The shards have a freeze rate of 40.

Added damage is applied at 120% effectiveness.

name: IceBolt
description: Cast a slow moving ice bolt to a location, where it creates an ice vortex that lasts for 4 seconds.

name: IceShield
description: Creates a shield in a target direction that repeatedly casts frostbolt in that direction.
altText:
Frostbolts are cold projectiles that create an ice explosion on hit.

The shards and explosions have a freeze rate of 12.

name: IceThorns
description: Releases a burst of homing ice thorns that deal physical and cold damage on hit and have a freeze rate of 18
altText:
Multiple thorns cannot hit the same target.

Freeze rate grants a chance to freeze on hit that is higher against enemies with lower health.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: Impale
description: Calls forth thorns from the earth, impaling enemies in a cone infront of you and causing them to bleed.

name: InfernalShade
description: Target enemy and all nearby enemies take fire damage per second. Each enemy can only have one Infernal Shade attached at a time. Expires after 5 seconds. Max 4 active shades.
altText:
Added spell damage applies at 250% effectiveness each second.

Your maximum number of shades is shared with Dread Shade.

name: Innervate
description: Grants 50 ward and grants 100% increased mana efficiency for 5 seconds. Can be cast instantly.

name: Javelin
description:
Hurl a javelin that pierces through every enemy in its path.

If you have a spear equipped added melee damage from the spear applies to Javelin as added throwing damage at 50% of its normal value. Added melee damage from other sources has no effect.

Added throwing damage applies at 250% effectiveness.
altText:
This is a throwing attack that scales with throwing attack damage and throwing attack speed.

The 250% added throwing damage effectiveness applies to all added throwing damage, including added throwing damage that was converted from your spear's added melee damage. So, equipping a spear with +100 Melee Damage causes Javelin to deal 125 additional damage.

name: Judgement
description:
A powerful melee attack that leaves an area of {Consecrated Ground} for 4 seconds.

Allies on the {Consecrated Ground} are healed for 50 health each second.

Enemies on Consecrate Ground take fire damage over time that scales with spell damage. Consecrate Ground gains 1 spell damage per 5% increased healing effectiveness.
altText:
Added melee damage applies to the attack at 350% effectiveness.

Added spell damage applies to Consecrated Ground at 375% effectiveness per second.

The melee attack's damage does not scale with spell damage and Consecrated Ground's damage does not scale with melee damage.

name: Lethal Mirage
description: Become immune for a duration and rapidly strike nearby targets with 6 mirages.
altText:
Mirages' added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

Increased Area for Area Skills stats apply to the attacks of individual mirages, but not to the maximum range at which mirages can be created.

name: LightningBlast
description: Hurl a bolt of lightning at the target. It chains to an additional enemy for each time it has been directly cast in the last 4 seconds, up to 2 times.
altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: LoadedDice
description: Guarantee a critical strike on your next hit.

name: Lunge
description: Dash to a nearby enemy and strike it with your weapon. Cannot be used without a target. Costs more mana the further away the target is.
altText:
Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

name: Maelstrom
description:
Surrounds you with a freezing Maelstrom that deals cold damage over time to nearby enemies.

Can be cast repeatedly to create multiple maelstroms at once. Each Maelstrom lasts 7 seconds.
altText:
Each Maelstrom has a base freeze rate per second of 24.

Added spell damage applies to each Maelstrom at 100% effectiveness per second.

name: Mage Evade
description:
Rapidly move a short distance forwards.

Evading does not grant damage immunity or prevent abilities from hitting you.

Evade gains 0.5% Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed per Character level.

name: ManaStrike
description: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you. If it hits at least one enemy, it creates a mana orb that returns to you and restores 15 mana.
altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: ManifestArmor
description:
Manifests an animated set of heavy armor, which attacks slowly.

Stats granted by your body armor, helmet, gloves and boots also apply to your Manifest Armor.
altText:
Manifested Armors have 400 base health.

Manifest Armor has a 30% chance to retaliate with {Forge Nova} when hit. This effect deals 40 spell fire damage with added damage applying at 200% effectiveness, applies fire resistance shred to enemies hit and has a 2 second cooldown.

name: ManifestWeapon
description: Manifests a melee weapon to attack in the target direction, without interrupting your other actions.

name: MarrowShards
description: Fires sharpened bones from your body. The bones pierce through enemies inflicting physical damage. Instead of mana, this spell costs 9% of your current health.
altText: Added damage is applied at 125% effectiveness.

name: Meteor
description: Call a meteor from the sky that deals a large amount of damage upon landing.
altText: Added damage is applied at 1200% effectiveness

name: MoltenBlade
description: A slashing attack that sweeps a wide area with a blade of molten steel. 25% physical and fire penetration.

name: Multistrike
description:
A melee attack that grants a stack of {Armament} if you hit at least one enemy with a direct use.

Armament stacks up to 2 times and each stack lasts 3 seconds.

Each stack of {Armament} causes an additional sword to strike a nearby enemy when you use Multistrike.
altText:
Additional swords cannot target the enemy you initially hit or enemies targeted by other swords.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: NorthernWinds
description: Cast a burst of frozen wind that deals cold damage to enemies it hits.
altText: Added damage is applied at 70% effectiveness.

name: NullAbility
description: Click to select an ability

name: Overgrowth
description: Grow larger increasing your physical prowess. Gain 15% increased critical strike multiplier, 20% increased vitality, 20% increased strength and 100 increased stun avoidance. This effect lasts 15 seconds.

name: PrimalChallenge
description: Pulls in nearby enemies, stunning them and increasing the duration of stuns on them for 5 seconds

name: Primalist Evade
description:
Rapidly move a short distance forwards.

Evading does not grant damage immunity or prevent abilities from hitting you.

Evade gains 0.5% Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed per Character level.

name: PrimalistSummonElemental
description:
Summon a manifestation of the elements to fight alongside you. The tide elemental is a permanent minion that uses cold spells.

If your minions are set to Assassinate mode, your tide elemental will teleport to its target when casting Geyser.
altText:
You can have a maximum of 1 elemental at a time. It uses a projectile spell with no cooldown, and can create a powerful Geyser spell that deals damage in an area, with a 4 second cooldown. It also casts Geyser when summoned.
Elementals have 400 base health.

name: Puncture
description: An extended melee stab or piercing bow attack that has a 30% chance to inflict bleed on hit. Bleeds inflicted by puncture have 30% increased duration.
altText:
When using a bow, Puncture deals 5% less damage to each subsequent enemy hit up to 20% less damage.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: RadiantLance
description:
Requires a shield.

Imbue your shield with light from above and concentrate it into a powerful beam that strikes enemies in front of you.

Deals 1% more damage per 1% uncapped block chance (multiplicative with other modifiers).
altText: Added damage is applied at 500% effectiveness.

name: Reaper Form Evade
description:
Rapidly move a short distance forwards.

Evading does not grant damage immunity or prevent abilities from hitting you.

Evade gains 0.5% Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed per Character level.

name: ReaperForm
description:
Take on the mantle of death itself and transform into a Reaper, temporarily gaining the Reap ability. 

While in Reaper Form, your health regen does not apply and your health decays over time. When your health reaches 0 instead of dying you transform back to human form and are healed to full health.
altText:
Reap is a short ranged dash. It deals melee damage to enemies you pass through and heals you for each enemy hit. This healing scales with your increased healing effectiveness.

The rate at which your health decays in reaper form is not based on your current or maximum health.

The health decay accelerates while you remain in reaper form.

If you take more damage than your remaining health in Reaper Form, the excess damage will be dealt to your human form health.

name: Rebuke
description:
Hold ability key to channel for up to 2 seconds. You take 80% less damage while channelling.

When you stop channelling the barrier breaks dealing physical damage to all nearby enemies. This deals 20 additional physical damage for each hit you received while channelling.
altText:
You cannot be stunned while channelling.

Added spell damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.

name: Ring Of Shields
description:
Manifests a ring of shields around you.

Each shield has 75 base health and lasts up to 10 seconds. Shields draw enemy aggression and block projectiles.

Stats on your equipped shield also apply to the shields created by Ring of Shields

name: RipBlood
description: Rips blood out of a target enemy dealing physical damage to it. An orb of the blood is drawn back to you, restoring 5 health when it reaches you.
altText:
Affected by increases to Healing Effectiveness.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: Rive1
description: A combo of three melee attacks. Every third consecutive attack with Rive slashes in a full circle around the character, dealing double damage.
altText:
The consecutive attack counter resets if you go 3 seconds without using Rive.

Added melee damage applies to the first two hits at 125% effectiveness and to the third hit at 250% effectiveness.

name: Rogue Evade
description:
Rapidly move a short distance forwards.

Evading does not grant damage immunity or prevent abilities from hitting you.

Evade gains 0.5% Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed per Character level.

name: RogueMultishot
description:
Requires a bow.

A bow attack that fires a cone of 5 arrows in the target direction. Aiming the cursor further from your character reduces the spread.
altText: Added damage is applied at 120% effectiveness

name: Runemaster 01 Frost Wall
description:
Creates a wall of frost which persists for 6 seconds. Enemies inside the wall take cold damage over time and receive a stack of chill every 0.25 seconds. You can have up to 1 active Frost Wall at a time.

Enemies that reach the wall at least 0.2 seconds after it's been created are frozen for twice as long as the wall has existed, up to a 2 second freeze duration. Bosses cannot be frozen in this way.
altText: Added spell damage applies at 400% effectiveness per second and the damage over time has a freeze rate of 80 per second.

name: Runemaster 02 Glyph of Dominion
description: Places a lightning glyph on the ground that grows over time. Deals lightning damage over time and slows in its area. At full size it detonates, dealing large amounts of lightning damage to enemies within its area. You can have a maximum of one Glyph at a time by default.
altText:
Added damage applies to the damage over time at 150% effectiveness each second, and to the explosion at 200% effectiveness.
The glyph and its explosion gain up to 150% more radius (multiplicative with other modifiers) over the course of its growth. Modifiers to duration do not affect the total growth.

name: Runemaster 04 Runic Invocation
description:
{Passive:} Whenever you directly use an elemental skill, gain 1 {Rune} of the corresponding element. For channelled skills you gain 1 rune per second instead.

{Active:} Consume all of your active {Runes} to cast a unique {Invocation} based on the combination and order of runes consumed.

The last {Rune} in the sequence determines the damage type.

Casting a fire skill grants a {Rah Rune}.
Casting a lightning skill grants a {Gon Rune}.
Casting a cold skill grants a {Heo Rune}.
altText: Added damage applies at varying effectiveness and for {Invocations}, but the more {Runes} you have before casting an {Invocation} the more powerful they become and the more mana they cost.

name: Runemaster 05 Channelled Runebolt
description: A combo spell that fires piercing projectiles. The first part of the combo is fire, the second is lightning, and the third is cold.
altText: Added damage applies at 100% effectiveness. The cold rune bolt has a freeze rate of 40.

name: Runemaster 05c1 Runebolt Fire
description: A combo spell that fires piercing projectiles. The first part of the combo is fire, the second is lightning, and the third is cold.
altText: Added damage applies at 125% effectiveness. The cold rune bolt has a freeze rate of 50.

name: Runemaster 06 Flame Rush
description: You turn into a ball of flame and launch yourself in the target direction. The longer you hold down the key, the slower you move, but the larger and more damaging the explosion is when you stop channeling. You take 40% less damage during Flame Rush.
altText:
Added damage applies to the hit from passing through enemies at 100% effectiveness, and to the explosion at 200% effectiveness.
The explosion gains up to 150% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and 150% increased area based on time spent channeling.

name: RuneWall
description: Summons a wall of roots at target location that slow and taunt nearby enemies.

name: Sacrifice
description: Rips apart an allied minion, dealing physical damage to enemies around it.
altText: Added damage is applied at 400% effectiveness.

name: Sentinel Evade
description:
Rapidly move a short distance forwards.

Evading does not grant damage immunity or prevent abilities from hitting you.

Evade gains 0.5% Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed per Character level.

name: SerpentStrike
description:
Requires a spear.

A melee attack with 140% poison chance.

Poisons inflicted by serpent strike last 40% longer.
altText:
Poison chance above 100% gives a chance to apply additional stacks of poison (this mechanic applies to all hits, not just Serpent Strike).

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: Shadow Form
description: Rapidly drains health and disables regaining health, but prevents being hit.

name: ShadowAssault
description: Three shadow clones appear around a target location and dash through it.

name: ShadowCascade
description:
Requires dual wielding.

A circular attack that's also used by your shadows.
altText: Added damages is applied at 250% effectiveness. Base critical strike chance is 10%, instead of the normal 5%.

name: ShadowRend
description:
Perform a short dash attack and manifest a shadow at your previous position, which will perform a sweeping melee attack or piercing bow attack for you after a short delay.

The shadow will persist afterwards for up to 5 seconds. Shadows will imitate your next direct use of Shadow Cascade, Shurikens, Umbral Blades, Explosive Trap, or Acid Flask. Shadows can also imitate indirect uses of Shadow Cascade. Up to 3 shadows can be active at once.
altText:
The initial attack has 100% damage effectiveness, and the shadow's attack has 500% damage effectiveness.

Modifiers to skills used by shadows affect the shadow's attack.

name: ShadowStep
description: Exchange locations with a shadow clone.

name: ShatterStrike
description:
A sweeping melee attack of 2 arcs that strikes enemies in a circle around you dealing cold damage and instantly kills frozen enemies below 10% health.

Enemies in the middle of the attack are hit twice, where the arcs overlap.
altText:
Has a freeze rate of 50.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: ShieldBash
description:
Requires a shield.

A melee directional attack that stuns enemies for 1 second. 100% increased stun duration against non-boss enemies.

1.5% more damage per 1% uncapped block chance (multiplicative with other modifiers).

20% of remaining cooldown recovered whenever you stun an enemy, including with Shield Bash itself. This effect can occur a maximum of two times each second.
altText:
Increased attack speed has no effect for Shield Bash.

Added damage is applied at 150% effectiveness.

name: ShieldRush
description:
Requires a shield.

Charge through enemies in the target direction until you release the ability key. You hit enemies in your path and in a wider area at the end of the movement. You do not regenerate mana while rushing.
altText:
Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

name: ShieldThrow
description:
Throws a shield at a target enemy. The shield ricochets to up to 2 additional targets before returning to you.

You cannot throw a new shield until the current shield has returned to you.
altText:
The shield hits all enemies in its path, even those it does not ricochet from.

Added throwing attack damage is applied at 225% effectiveness.

name: Shift
description: Dash a short fixed distance in the target direction.
altText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

name: Shurikens
description: Throw 3 shurikens in a cone.
altText:
Added damage applies at 125% effectiveness.
Your shadows can imitate this ability when you directly use it.

name: SigilsOfHope
description:
Every 2 seconds, summons a symbol that orbits you, causing you and your allies' attacks and spells to deal 3 additional fire damage and increasing health regeneration by 20%.

Activate to consume the symbols, granting 100 ward and 5% less damage taken per symbol for 3 seconds.

You can have up to 3 symbols at a time.

name: SkyBolt
description: A bolt of holy fire descends from the sky directly on to a targeted enemy.

name: SmeltersWrath
description:
Channel to charge a powerful frontal cone attack, dealing fire and physical damage to all enemies hit. Charging for longer increases its range and power. 2 second maximum charge time.

Your armor is doubled while channelling Smelter's Wrath.
altText:
Deals up to 100% more damage at maximum charge.

Added damage is applied at 600% effectiveness.

Increased Area for Area Skills stats increase Smelter's Wrath's charge speed instead of its area.

name: Smite
description:
Smites a target enemy with a bolt of holy fire that descends from the sky, healing allies around the target for 60 health. If you are in the area you are also healed.

Cannot be used without a target.
altText: Added spell damage applies at 150% effectiveness

name: Smoke Bomb
description: Drop a Smoke Bomb at your feet that blinds enemies and grants you haste while you remain inside it. The Smoke Bomb grows in size over its duration. Lasts 4 seconds.
altText: You can have a maximum of 2 smoke bombs active at once.

name: SnapFreeze
description:
Freezes enemies in a cone in front of you. Freeze lasts for 2 seconds.

20% of remaining cooldown recovered whenever you freeze an enemy, including with Snap Freeze itself. This effect can occur a maximum of two times each second.

name: SoulSpear
description: Cast a piercing projectile at your enemies. Soul Lance has a higher than average critical strike chance.

name: SpiritPlague
description: Curses a target with a powerful necrotic damage over time effect which lasts 3 seconds. Spreads to a single nearby target on target death.
altText: Added spell damage applies at 150% effectiveness per second.

name: SprigganForm
description:
Transform into a forest spriggan, increasing your spell casting capabilities, and gaining 4 new abilities.

Your mana is replaced with Rage while in spriggan form. When your Rage reaches 0 you automatically transform back into your human form. Your starting Rage is equal to your maximum mana. Rage slowly decays over time at a constant rate.
altText:
The four new abilities are: Spirit Thorns, Thorn Shield, Summon Vine and Summon Healing Totem.

While in spriggan form you have 50% increased spell damage and +300 armor.

When returning to human form, your mana will return to the amount you had before shapeshifting, but you will have gained the mana you regenerated while shapeshifted. Other forms of mana recovery do not apply.

name: SprigganForm Evade
description:
Rapidly move a short distance forwards.

Evading does not grant damage immunity or prevent abilities from hitting you.

Evade gains 0.5% Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed per Character level.

name: Static
description:
Static charges up as you move or when you get hit. Activate Static to discharge what you have built up, striking up to 5 nearby enemies with lightning.

100 charges maximum. Deals 4% more damage per charge.
altText:
By default static gains 5 charges per second while moving, and also gains 5 charges whenever you take a hit.

Added spell damage applies at 250% effectiveness.

name: StaticOrb
description: Casts an orb in a target direction that deals lightning damage and pulls enemies that it hits towards it as it travels. At the target location it explodes, dealing lightning damage to enemies surrounding it and also striking up to 5 enemies further out. The further it travels the higher the damage and area of effect of the explosion, up to 100%.
altText:
As the area of effect of the explosion increases so does the maximum range at which it can strike additional enemies. Increased Area for Area Skills stats also affect both and are additive with this increase.

Static Orb's added damage is applied at 150% effectiveness and the explosion added damages is applied at 300% effectiveness.

name: SummonBallista
description: Summons a ballista that fires bolts at nearby enemies.
altText: Ballistae have 1000 base health and last 10 seconds by default. Enemies rarely target ballistas.

name: SummonBear
description:
Summons a primal bear that follows you into combat. When its health drops to 0 it is downed, and you can stand near it to revive it.

The bear counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.
altText: Primals bears have 300 base health and is resistant to powerful area attacks.

name: SummonBoneGolem
description: Summons a bone golem, which attacks slowly, but has a 15% chance to retaliate with Bone Shatter when hit.
altText: Bone golems have 400 base health.

name: SummonFrenzyTotem
description: Summons a totem that grants Frenzy to all nearby allies. Frenzy increases attack and cast speed by 20%.
altText: Frenzy totems have 120 base health and last 6 seconds.

name: SummonMage
description:
Summons a Skeletal Mage to assist you. You are limited to 2 Skeletal Mages at a time.
Skeletal Mages cast Dread Bolt, which has 150% added damage effectiveness and has a 50% chance to apply Damned on hit.
altText:
Skeletal Mages have 100 base health.

You will always summon the Skeletal Mage type you have the fewest of.

name: SummonRaptor
description:
Summons a primal raptor that ferociously attacks your enemies. When its health drops to 0 it is downed, and you can stand near it to revive it.

The raptor counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.
altText: The raptor has 240 base health and is resistant to powerful area attacks.

name: SummonRunicElemental
description: Summons a bone golem, which attacks slowly, but has a 15% chance to retaliate with bone nova when hit.
altText: Bone golems have 400 base health. Press A to give your minions an attack command.

name: SummonSabertooth
description:
Summons a primal sabertooth cat that leaps into combat. When its health drops to 0 it is downed, and you can stand near it to revive it.

The sabertooth cat counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.
altText: The sabertooth has 240 base health and is resistant to powerful area attacks.

name: SummonScorpion
description:
Summons a scorpion that follows you into combat. Its attacks with its tails inflict a long lasting poison. When its health drops to 0 it is downed, and you can stand near it to revive it.

The scorpion counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.
altText: The scorpion has 400 base health and is resistant to powerful area attacks.

name: SummonSkeleton
description: Summons a skeleton warrior or skeleton archer to guard you. You are limited to 3 skeletons at a time.
altText:
Skeletons have 100 base health.

You will always summon the skeleton type you have the fewest of.

Increased Area for Minion Area Skills stats affect summoned skeletons' melee attacks.

name: SummonSpriggan
description:
Summon a spriggan that casts spells to attack your enemies and has a passive Healing Aura that restores 10 health per second. When its health drops to 0 it is downed, and you can stand near it to revive it.

The spriggan counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.
altText: The spriggan has 160 base health and is resistant to powerful area attacks.

name: SummonStormCrow
description:
Summons Storm Crows up to your companion limit. The Storm Crow casts spells from a distance. When its health drops to 0 it is downed, and you can stand near it to revive it.

The Storm Crow counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.
altText: The crow has 200 base health and is resistant to powerful area attacks.

name: SummonStormTotem
description:
Summons a totem that casts lightning storms around nearby enemies.

Storm totems last 8 seconds, and you cannot control more than 1 at once.
altText: Storm totems have 120 base health

name: SummonThornTotem
description: Summons a totem that fires thorns at nearby enemies. You can have a maximum of two thorn totems by default.
altText:
Totems scale with your minion or totem stats, not your stats.
Added minion spell damage applies at 100% effectiveness for the Thorns fired by the Thorn Totem.

Thorn totems have 120 base health and last 6 seconds by default.

name: SummonVolatileZombie
description: Summons a Volatile Zombie which trudges towards the nearest enemy. When it reaches an enemy or dies, it explodes dealing physical and fire damage to surrounding enemies.
altText:
You are limited to 6 active zombies. Summoning more will cause older ones to explode.

Volatile Zombies have 200 base health and their health decays at an accelerating rate. Their explosion has 600% effectiveness of added spell damage.

name: SummonWolf
description:
Summons a primal wolf that follows you into combat. When its health drops to 0 it is downed, and you can stand near it to revive it.

While you have your maximum number of wolves, the ability is replaced with {Howl}.

The wolf counts as a companion. You can have a maximum of two companions at once by default.
altText: The Wolf has 220 base health and is resistant to powerful area attacks.

name: SummonWraith
description: Summons a wraith that rapidly fades from this world, but will seek and attack your foes while it remains.
altText:
You are limited to 6 active wraiths.

Wraiths have 60 base health.

name: Surge
description: Quick fixed distance dash which hits all enemies in the path with a lightning melee attack.
altText:
Added melee damage applies at 200% effectiveness.

Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

name: Swarmblade Evade
description:
Rapidly move a short distance forwards.

Evading does not grant damage immunity or prevent abilities from hitting you.

Evade gains 0.5% Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed per Character level.

name: Swarmblade Form
description:
Transform into an agile Swarmblade, increasing your melee capabilities, and gaining 4 new abilities.

Your mana is replaced with Rage while in swarmblade form. When your Rage reaches 0 you automatically transform back into your human form. Your starting Rage is equal to your maximum mana. Rage slowly decays over time at a constant rate.
altText:
The four new abilities are: Armblade Slashes, Swarm Strike, Dash and Summon Hive.

While in Swarmblade Form you have 10% increased melee attack speed and movement speed.

When returning to human form, your mana will return to the amount you had before shapeshifting, but you will have gained the mana you regenerated while shapeshifted. Other forms of mana recovery do not apply.

name: Swipe
description: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you. Unaffected by weapon range.
altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: Swipe2
description: A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you. Unaffected by weapon range.
altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: SynchronizedStrike
description:
Requires a melee weapon.

Jump forward and strike in an area in front of you while shadows appear and simultaneously strike on either side of you.

The shadows will persist afterwards for up to 5 seconds. Shadows will imitate your next direct use of Shadow Cascade, Shurikens, Umbral Blades, Explosive Trap, or Acid Flask. Shadows can also imitate indirect uses of Shadow Cascade. Up to 3 shadows can be active at once.
altText: Added damage applies to each hit at 300% effectiveness.

name: Teleport
description: Teleport to target location.
altText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

name: TempestStrike
description:
A melee combo attack that cycles through a cold strike, a physical strike, and a lightning strike that trigger elemental {Tempest} spells of the same damage type if the strikes hit at least one enemy.

Cold strike: Triggers a {Frigid Tempest}, which is a cold projectile that pierces through enemies.
Physical strike: Triggers a {Wind Tempest}, which is a small twister that lasts a short duration dealing physical damage per over time.
Lightning strike: Triggers a {Thunder Tempest}, which is an expanding storm of lightning bolts.
altText:
Added damage for the melee strikes apply at 200% effectiveness.

{Frigid Tempest}: Added damage applies at 300% effectiveness.
{Wind Tempest}: Added damage applies at 200% effectiveness per second.
{Thunder Tempest}: Added damage applies at 200% effectiveness.

name: Tornado
description: Conjures a tornado that moves at random, pulling in nearby enemies and dealing physical damage to them.
altText: Added damage applies to the damage over time at 150% effectiveness per second.

name: Transplant
description:
Creates a new body for you at the target location, then detonates your old body to deal physical damage to enemies around it.

Instead of mana, this spell costs 13% of your current health.
altText:
Added damage is applied at 250% effectiveness.

Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

name: Umbral Blades 1
description:
A combo ability that throws 2 blades, then 4 blades, then recalls all blades in the ground back to you, hitting enemies along the way.

An enemy can be hit by multiple blades from the same throw and by multiple blades from the recall.

Only the first part of the combo costs mana.
altText:
Added damage applies at 60% effectiveness. 40% less chance to apply ailments on hit.
Your shadows can imitate this ability when you directly use it. Shadows using Umbral Blades always throw a single blade that deals 300% more damage and has 100% increased radius.

Umbral Blades can persist in the ground for up to 6 seconds.

name: Upheaval
description: Sunders the ground in a line in front of you, dealing damage to enemies along the path.
altText: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.

name: Vengeance
description:
A melee attack that also prepares you to riposte incoming hits.

If vengeance successfully hits an enemy and you take a hit in the next 2 seconds you will riposte, taking 25% less damage and striking at a nearby enemy.
altText: Added damage is applied at 125% effectiveness to the initial hit and 150% effectiveness to the riposte.

name: VenomStrike
description: A slow melee attack that poisons and release a spray of venom

name: VoidCleave
description:
Requires a 2-handed sword or axe.

A melee attack that hits all enemies in an area in front of you. Can be echoed by Void Knights. Unaffected by weapon range.
altText: Added damage applies at 400% effectiveness.

name: VolatileReversal
description: A combo ability that jumps forwards in time to a target location and performs a melee attack on arrival. Recast within 3 seconds to jump backwards in time to your original location and perform a melee attack on arrival.
altText:
Added damage applies to the melee attacks at 200% effectiveness.

Volatile Reversal's cooldown continues recovering while the recast is available.

name: VolcanicOrb
description: Casts a fiery orb that spews burning shrapnel in all directions.
altText: Added damage applies to the orb at 200% effectiveness, and to the shrapnel at 100% effectiveness.

name: WanderingSpirits
description:
Reveals wandering spirits around you for 6 seconds. The spirits wander at random dealing necrotic damage over time to enemies they pass through.

4 spirits are revealed immediately after casting the skill and 17 more are revealed over the next 6 seconds.

The spirits individually last up to 4 seconds, but all remaining spirits fade once the reveal duration ends.
altText:
Added spell damage applies to each spirit's damage at 200% effectiveness per second.

Increased Area stats affect the area of effect of each individual spirit, but not the area in which spirits are revealed.

name: Warcry
description:
Unleash a mighty roar that knocks back nearby enemies and stuns them for 1.5 seconds. Rares and bosses are stunned for half as long.

20% of remaining cooldown recovered whenever you stun (or freeze if Warcry is converted to cold) an enemy, including with Warcry itself. This effect can occur a maximum of two times each second.

name: Warlock 01 Chaos Bolts
description: A barrage of chaotic projectiles which land in an area around the target. The explosions deal necrotic and fire damage in a small area.
altText:
Added damage applies at 100% effectiveness for each bolt.

Increased Area for Area Skills stats increase the size of the individual explosions, but not the spread of the projectiles.

name: Warlock 02 Ghostflame
description: Channel to releases a continuous jet of horrid flames in front of you dealing fire and necrotic damage over time.
altText: Added damage applies at 600% effectiveness each second. Damage reduces while rotating.

name: Warlock 03 SoulFeast
description:
Feasts on the souls of {Cursed} enemies, dealing necrotic damage to them, and drawing fragments of their souls back to you. The soul fragments each grant 3 ward when they reach you.

Feasts on up to 13 enemies, prioritising those closest to you.
altText: Added spell damage is applied at 250% effectiveness.

name: Warlock 04 Chthonic Fissure
description:
Opens an infernal fissure in the ground, dealing fire damage over time to enemies on top of it, as well as releasing {Spirits} from the fissure that seek nearby enemies. These spirits inflict enemies with {Torment}, a {Curse} that slows and deals necrotic damage over time.

Max 1 active fissure.
altText:
Added damage for the {Fissure} applies at 120% effectiveness each second.

Added damage for the {Spirits} applies at 30% effectiveness.

{Torment} applies 18% less movement speed (multiplicative with other modifiers), deals 120 damage over 3 seconds and added damage applies at 200% effectiveness per second.

name: Warlock 05 Profane Veil
description:
Channel to conceal yourself within a Profane Veil that deals necrotic damage over time to enemies around you. While concealed you dodge every Hit, but you can still take damage from damage over time effects, such as ailments, and you move more slowly.

Last for up to 2 seconds (also ends when you release the key). Cooldown does not recover during use.
altText:
You have 40% less movement speed while channeling (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Added spell damage applies at 200% effectiveness per second.

name: Warpath
description: Spin towards the mouse while you hold down the ability key, striking nearby enemies as you move.
altText:
You have 20% less movement speed while spinning (multiplicative with other modifiers). Hits at twice your attack rate, but added damage applies at 60% effectiveness and there is a 40% less chance to apply ailments on hit. 

You cannot be stunned while spinning.

Not affected by weapon range.

name: Werebear Evade
description:
Rapidly move a short distance forwards.

Evading does not grant damage immunity or prevent abilities from hitting you.

Evade gains 0.5% Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed per Character level.

name: WerebearForm
description:
Transform into a ferocious werebear, increasing your physical capabilities and gaining 4 new abilities. 

Your mana is replaced with Rage while in werebear form. When your Rage reaches 0 you automatically transform back into your human form. Your starting Rage is equal to your maximum mana. Rage slowly decays over time at a constant rate.
altText:
The four new abilities are: Rampage, Swipe, Maul and Roar. Swipe and Roar inherit all bonuses from your Swipe and Warcry skill trees.

While in bear form you have 50% increased melee damage and 15% increased health.

When returning to human form, your mana will return to the amount you had before shapeshifting, but you will have gained the mana you regenerated while shapeshifted. Other forms of mana recovery do not apply.

name: Abomination Double Strike
description: Two rapid melee attacks which strike all enemies in front of the abomination.
altText: Added damage applies at 200% effectiveness for each hit of Double Strike.

name: Abomination EternalArrow
description:
The abomination's archer shoots an arrow that seeks the heart of a nearby target, passing harmlessly through other enemies. Whenever it hits its target it has a chance to continue through it and {Recurve} to strike it again. 

Subsequent {Recurve} chance is multiplied by 0.8 each time the arrow {Recurves}. If the target dies, it will choose a new target.
altText:
Base recurve chance is 100%.

Added damage applies at 100% effectiveness.

name: Abomination Minion Stomp
description: The abomination stomps the ground, dealing physical damage to enemies in the area.
altText: Added damage is applied at 300% effectiveness.

name: AbyssalOrb
description:
An orb of pure void energy that seeks out your enemies, dealing a large amount of void damage to the target and a smaller amount in an area around them.

Added spell damage applies to the primary hit at 200% effectiveness and at 100% to the area of effect.

name: ArcaneLightning
description: Hurl a bolt of lightning at the target.
altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: Aura of Decay Cold Retaliation
description: An icy wave that erupts from you which deals no damage, but has 400 Freeze Rate.

name: AuraOfRot
description: An aura surrounding the abomination which poisons it every second. Enemies near it are poisoned four times a second, and the abomination's chance to poison on hit applies to each of these instances at 25% effectiveness.

name: Avalanche Fissure
description: Open a fissure underneath your enemies, dealing physical damage over time for 4 seconds.
altText: Added spell damage is applied at 200% effectiveness per second.

name: AvalancheSnowballAoE
description: Launches an icy boulder from the sky.
altText: Added damage is applied at 300% effectiveness.

name: AxeThrow
description: Throws an axe at a nearby enemy.
altText:
This is a throwing attack that scales with throwing attack damage and throwing attack speed. It is not a melee attack or spell.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: BackwardVoidBeam
description: A void beam that deals spell damage over time.
altText: Added damage is applied at 300% effectiveness each second.

name: Ballista Explosion
description:
Trigger explosive devices, damaging enemies in a small area.

Your Ballista's added bow damage is applied at 250% effectiveness.

name: BearThornBurst
description: Releases a burst of thorns, damaging all nearby enemies.
altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: BlackHoleEnd
description: A wave of cold energy that erupts from Black Hole. Has a freeze rate of 240.
altText: Added spell damage is applied at 300% effectiveness.

name: BladeStormExplosion
description: The Bladestorm detonates, causing an explosion of damage in an area that is twice the size of the Bladestorm.
altText: Added damage applies at 500% effectiveness.

name: Blizzard
description: Repeatedly strikes around a target area with hail, wind and frozen objects.
altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: BloodPool
description: Leave a pool for blood for 3 seconds that slows enemies.

name: BloodSplatter
description:
Blood Splatter is a physical spell dealing damage to other enemies around the target, but not the original target. 

Added damage applies at 50% effectiveness.

name: Bone Golem 09 Blood Orb
description:
Launches an orb of blood that hits up to 3 nearby enemies 6 times over 2 seconds.

Added spell damage applies at 300% effectiveness to each hit.

name: Bone Golem 10 Freezing Grasp
description: Creates a nova around the caster that deals cold damage and has a freeze rate of 200.
altText: Added damage applies at 200% effectiveness.

name: BoneArmor
description: A protective coating of bone armor which grants 8% less damage taken for 4 seconds.

name: BoneEruption
description: Bones erupt from the ground, dealing physical damage to enemies in the area.

name: BoneShatter
description: Bones fly out in all directions, impaling enemies.
altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: BoneSplinters
description:
Unleashes multiple splinters of bone in a cone behind Marrow Shards.
An enemy can only be hit by Marrow Shards or one projectile from Bone Splinters.
altText: Added damage is applied at 125% effectiveness.

name: Burning Dagger Throw
description: Launch a burning dagger at a nearby enemy.
altText: Added damage is applied at 150% effectiveness.

name: Burning Dagger Throw 5 of them
description: Launch a cone of burning daggers at nearby enemies.
altText: Added damage is applied at 150% effectiveness.

name: BurningGround
description: A Burning patch on the ground which ignites all enemies twice per second.

name: BurstOfFlame
description: A burst of flame that deals high damage in an area around the target.
altText: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.

name: ChainingIceNova
description: Creates a cascade of freezing novas. Whenever an enemy is hit by a nova another one is created around them. Each ice nova has a freeze rate of 40.
altText:
Added damage applies at 120% effectiveness.
Each enemy can only be hit by a maximum of one freezing nova.

name: Chakram
description: Throw a single Chakram that pierces through all enemies, rebounds off terrain, and returns to you. Enemies can be hit a second time when the Chakram is returning.
altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: Coagulated Blood Explosion
description:
Combine the excess coagulated blood into an orb that seeks out the nearest enemy and explodes, hitting all nearby enemies.
Added damage applies at 150% effectiveness.

name: ConsecratedGround
description:
Allies on the consecrated ground are healed for 50 health each second.

Enemies on Consecrate Ground take fire damage over time that scales with spell damage. Consecrate Ground gains 1 Spell Damage per 5% increased healing effectiveness.

Added spell damage applies at 375% effectiveness per second.

name: CreateShadow
description:
Create a Shadow of yourself that persists for up to 5 seconds and will imitate your next direct use of Shadow Cascade, Shurikens, Umbral Blades, Dreamslash or Acid Flask. Shadows can also imitate indirect uses of Shadow Cascade.
Up to 3 Shadows can be active at once.

name: DarkBlade
description: Launches a blade towards an enemy, dealing melee physical damage.
altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: DeathSealWave
description: Releases a Wave of Death dealing damage based on how long Death Seal has been actve and your current percent missing health.
altText: Added damage applies at 500% effectiveness.

name: Decoy Small Explosion
description: Trigger small hidden explosives hidden in your Decoy, damaging enemies near it.
altText: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.

name: Decoy Sonic Wave
description: Your Decoy emits a piercing sound that afflicts enemies around it with armor shred and frailty.

name: Defiled Nova
description:
A wave of defilement erupts from you, hitting enemies in an expanding area dealing spell physical damage on hit. 

Your poison chance applies at 500% of its normal value to the wave's hits.

name: DetonateGround
description: After a short delay the ground erupts in a firey explosion.
altText: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.

name: DetonationChainLightning
description: A bolt of lightning created by the detonation, jumping to nearby enemies.

name: DevouringSouls
description:
Calls forth five hungering souls that seeks out enemies, on hit they deal necrotic damage and then possesses the target.

Possessed enemies take necrotic damage over time for 1.5 seconds. Enemies cannot be possessed by multiple souls at once.
altText:
Possess's damage counts as spell damage and it is affected by modifiers to base spell damage.

Added spell damage applies to the initial hit at 200% and to possess at 100% per second for 1.5 seconds.

name: DivineBolt
description: Cast a bolt of divine fire towards the target.
altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: DivineFlare
description: A holy blast which deals spell fire damage to nearby enemies.
altText: Added damage applies at 350% effectiveness.

name: DoomBrandExplosion
description: A brand that persists on its target indefinitely. When the target dies, the Doom Brand erupts, dealing necrotic damage in an area around it.
altText: Added damage is applied at 400% effectiveness.

name: EarthquakeAftershock
description: Seeks out targets and erupts, damaging all nearby enemies.
altText: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness

name: EnchantWeapon FireExplosion
description: An explosion that deals fire damage in an area.
altText: Added damage applies at 200% effectiveness.

name: EnergyWave
description: Release a small wave of spell physical energy that has a set distance and travels through enemies.
altText: Added damage is applied at 150% effectiveness.

name: EnsnaringRoots
description:
Call forth a wave of roots that grows outwards in a wide cone in front of you. The wave deals physical damage and roots enemies it hits for 1.5 seconds. Rooted enemies take physical damage over time until they are freed.


Added spell damage applies at 100% to the initial hit and 200% per second to the damage over time.
altText: Added spell damage applies to the damage over time at 200% effectiveness per second.

name: ExplosiveFlaskExplosion
description: Throw a highly explosive flask at a target.
altText: Added damage is applied at 250% effectiveness.

name: Falconer 00.1 Feather Knives
description:
Your {Falcon} throws out several sharp feathers at nearby enemies dealing physical damage and scales with the Falcon's throwing damage.

This effect has a 10 second cooldown.
altText: Added damage applies at 250% effectiveness.

name: Falconer 00.4 Caltrops
description:
Creates an area of sharp {Caltrops} that deals physical damage when enemies first walk over them.

Enemies can only take damage once per {Caltrops} area, but stacking multiple on top of each other will still cause enemies to take damage from each of the areas.
altText: Added damage applies at 200% effectiveness.

name: Falconer 02.1 Aerial Assault Feather Burst
description: After Aerial Assault your {Falcon} releases a quick burst of sharp feathers from its wings at nearby enemies dealing physical damage that scales with the Falcon's throwing damage.
altText: Added throwing damage applies at 200% effectiveness.

name: Falconer 02.2 Featherstorm
description: A torrent of sharp feathers that rain down over enemies dealing physical damage over time and scales with the Falcon's throwing damage.
altText: Added damage applies at 250% effectiveness each second.

name: Falconer 03.2 Feather Rain
description: Razorsharp feathers fall from the sky striking enemies in a wide area around the target location dealing physical damage and scales with the {Falcon's} throwing damage.
altText: Added damage applies at 400% effectiveness.

name: Falconer 06 Net Trap
description:
Throws a trap that releases a net at a nearby enemy when it triggers.

You can have a maximum of 6 Net Traps active at once and they last up to 30 seconds.
altText:
Added throwing attack damage is applied at 600% effectiveness to the explosion.

The Decoy cannot be destroyed before it expires.

name: Fire Fissure
description: Open a fissure underneath your enemies, dealing spell fire damage over time for 3 seconds.
altText: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness each second.

name: FireAura
description: Deals fire damage in an area around you. Each stack lasts for 4 seconds. Can be converted to cold or lightning.
altText: Added spell damage is applied at 140% effectiveness per second.

name: FireballAoe
description: A burst of flame that deals high damage in an area around the target.
altText: Added damage is applied at 500% effectiveness.

name: FireExplosion
description: An explosion that deals fire damage in an area.
altText: Added damage applies at 100% effectiveness.

name: FireNova
description: Casts a nova around you that deals fire damage.
altText: Added damage is applied at 130% effectiveness.

name: Flame Whip
description: A fire whip that lashes at a nearby enemy.
altText: Added damage is applied at 300% effectiveness.

name: FlameTrail
description:
Creates a trail of holy fire and lightning which damages enemies standing on it.

Added spell damage applies at 250% effectiveness per second.

name: FlameWave
description: Launch a wave of flame toward the target, hitting all enemies in its path.
altText: Added damage is applied at 300% effectiveness.

name: Flay Blood Explosion
description: Blood erupts from the enemy, dealing physical spell damage to it and all other enemies in an area.
altText: Added spell damage applies at 200% effectiveness.

name: FlurryWave
description:
Strike with such force that your blows extend further, granting additional range. Does not hit targets already hit by the attack that generated the Force Wave.
This still counts as a melee attack.
altText: Added damage is applied at 50% effectiveness.

name: ForgeFlames
description: Radiates extreme heat, dealing fire damage to enemies within 2.5 meters.
altText: Added spell damage is applied at 200% effectiveness per second.

name: ForwardVoidBeam
description: A void beam that deals spell damage over time.
altText: Added damage is applied at 300% effectiveness each second.

name: FrostNova
description: A circle of biting frost that deals cold damage and has a chance to freeze on hit.
altText:
Frost Nova has a freeze rate of 40.

Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: FrostWallDetonation
description: Creates an explosion of cold spell damage after a brief delay
altText: Added spell damage applies at 100% effectiveness

name: Furnace
description:
Spews sweltering heat in a cone in front of you, dealing fire damage over time.

Added damage applies at 240% effectiveness per second.

name: HeallingHands 007 SkyBeam
description: A Holy Beam descends from the sky dealing fire damage over time to enemies in the target area, and healing allies in the target area for 50 health per second.

name: HolyEruption
description: An eruption of holy power that deals spell fire damage to enemies and heals 80 health to nearby allies.
altText: Added damage applies at 200% effectiveness.

name: HolyFlameBurst
description: Creates a burst of holy fire around you.
altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: HolySymbol
description: A triggered self heal that also grants ward every second over 3 seconds. It has a 3 second cooldown.

name: IceNova
description: Casts a nova around you that deals cold damage.
altText: Added damage is applied at 120% effectiveness.

name: IceShard
description: Cast a razor sharp shard of ice at the target direction.
altText: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.

name: IceVortex
description: Cast a swirling vortex of cold damage over time that lasts for 4 seconds.
altText: Added damage is applied at 40% effectiveness per second.

name: Icicle
description: Cast an arc of ice spikes towards your enemy.
altText: Added spell damage is applied at 300% effectiveness.

name: JavelinLightningSpear
description: A spear of lightning that emerges from the Javelin and seeks out a nearby enemy, piercing all in its path.
altText: Added damage applies at 100% effectiveness.

name: LavaBurst
description: Cast a burst of molten lava, hitting the target and nearby enemies dealing spell fire damage.
altText: Added damage is applied at 200% effectiveness.

name: LightningNova
description: Casts a nova around you that deals lightning damage.
altText: Added damage is applied at 120% effectiveness.

name: LightningWave
description: Release a wave of lightning in an area around you.
altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: Locust Swarm
description:
Surrounds you with a swarm of locusts that deals melee damage over time.

Has a base duration of 4 seconds. Only one Locust Swarm can exist at once.
altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: MageLightning
description: An arc of lightning from your mana blade that strikes each enemy hit by Mana Strike.
altText: Added damage is applied at 150% effectiveness.

name: Manifest Armor 02 ForgeBreath
description: Deals fire damage in a cone. Added spell damage applies a 350% effectiveness.

name: Manifest Armor 03 Whirlwind Strike
description: The Manifest Armor quickly spins, hitting all enemies around it. Added damage applies at 300% effectiveness.

name: Manifest Armor 04 Charge
description: Charge at a nearby enemy, knocking back and dealing physical damage to enemies hit along the path.

name: Manifest Armor Sweeping Strike
description: Your Manifest Armor performs a sweeping melee attack, hitting all enemies around it.
altText: Added minion melee damage applies at 250% effectiveness.

name: MarkForDeath
description: Curses the enemy, reducing all resistances by 25% for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.

name: MeteorShrapnel
description: Fires a piece of burning shrapnel in a random direction.
altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: NecroticExplosion
description: Create a burst of necrotic damage in an area around the target.
altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: NecroticMortar
description: Launches a necrotic orb in an arc. It explodes when it reaches the target.

name: OldDischarge
description: Zaps up to five nearby enemies, dealing lightning damage.
altText: Added damage is applied at 250% effectiveness.

name: PhysicalNova
description: Destroy your enemies so forcefully that they generate a burst of physical damage around them as they die.
altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: PoisonBoltAoD
description: Launch a projectile that inflicts poison.
altText: Added damage is applied at 100% effectiveness.

name: PoisonNova
description: Unleash a nova that poisons enemies, and has 25% increased effect of poison.

name: PoisonPool
description: Leave a pool of poison the ground for several seconds that poisons enemies within it each second.

name: PrimalBear Teleport
description: Your bear teleports towards an enemy at an unbearable speed.

name: PrimalLightning
description: Call forth a bolt of lightning to strike the area.
altText: Added damage applies at 115% effectiveness.

name: Profane Orb Explosion
description:
An orb of profane energy that seeks out the nearest enemy and explodes, hitting all nearby enemies.
Added damage applies at 200% effectiveness.

name: ProfaneOblation
description: Rips apart an allied minion, dealing necrotic damage to enemies around it. Added spell damage applies at 350% effectiveness.

name: PutridBomb
description:
Create a globule of poison that bursts after 1 second.

Your poison chance applies at 250% of its normal value to hits from this ability.

name: Pyre Golem InfernalAura
description: Deals a burst of fire damage, then fire damage over time around the caster for 10 seconds. Ignites enemies within its area every second.
altText: Added damage applies to the burst at 300% effectiveness, and to the damage over time at 100% effectiveness per second.

name: RaptorFireBreath
description: Your raptor breathes fire on enemies in a cone in front of it, dealing fire spell damage over time for 1 second.
altText: Added spell damage applies at 400% effectiveness per second.

name: RaptorScreech
